ticket: I was charged twice for the same order
resolution: Duplicate charges are usually reversed automatically. If the duplicate charge remains, contact billing support with your order ID.

ticket: I don't recognize a charge on my account
resolution: Check your recent orders and payment history. If the charge is still unfamiliar, contact billing support immediately.
Check that your payment method has sufficient funds and that the card details are correct. You can also try another payment method.
Use the password reset option on the login page and follow the instructions sent to your registered email.
Wait for the temporary lock to expire or use the account recovery process to regain access.

ticket: I cannot log into my account
resolution: Verify your email and password. If you still cannot log in, use the password reset or account recovery option.
Restart the application and make sure you are using the latest version. If the issue continues, provide the error message to technical support.
Check your internet connection and refresh the page. If the problem persists, try another browser or clear the browser cache.
Contact support with your order ID and a photo of the received item. Support will provide return or replacement instructions.
Check your order tracking information using the tracking link provided in your order confirmation.
Check the latest tracking update. If the estimated delivery date has passed, contact support with your order ID.

ticket: I want to cancel my order and get my money back
resolution: If the order has not been shipped, request cancellation through your order page. Eligible refunds are processed after cancellation.

ticket: How long does a refund take?
resolution: Refund processing time depends on the payment method. Check your refund confirmation for the expected processing period.

ticket: I need a refund for my purchase
resolution: Submit a refund request from your order page. Eligibility depends on the purchase and refund policy.
